items.title: Jemma Stapleton's brother shares devastated tribute after 25yo Australian sprinter dies in Thailand
items.description: The brother of Stawell Gift finalist Jemma Stapleton remembers her "bright smile" and expresses gratitude for the outpouring of grief and support.

items.title: NDIS labour hire company enters administration, 480 jobs in limbo
items.description: NDIS labour hire provider United Foundation has entered voluntary administration blaming regulatory changes, delayed payments and rising costs.

items.title: ASX ends week on a high as investors await SpaceX share launch — as it happened
items.description: The ASX end the week on a high amid hopes of a Middle East peace deal, while SpaceX's IPO prepares for lift-off on the Nasdaq. See how the trading day unfolded on the ABC News live markets blog.

items.title: One Nation's Melbourne fundraiser moved over protest concerns
items.description: A One Nation fundraiser in Melbourne has been moved to an undisclosed location after several protest groups vowed to demonstrate outside, the party says.

items.title: Billionaire says $150m court loss no reason to change approach to native title
items.description: Mining magnate Andrew "Twiggy" Forrest has defended his company's approach to Indigenous agreements after a court ordered the miner to pay $150 million in compensation to the Yindjibarndi people.

items.title: World Cup quick hits: Opening ceremony delights, drinks break drama and Haiti's jersey ban
items.description: The 2026 FIFA World Cup is up and running, launched by a colourful opening ceremony and comprehensive win for Mexico. Here are the quick hits from the opening day of the tournament.

items.title: Ex pro cyclist Rohan Dennis reported for driving while disqualified, ABC understands
items.description: Rohan Dennis was handed a suspended sentence last year for the events leading up to the death of his Olympian wife Melissa Hoskins in December 2023.

items.title: Murderer's mum uses ChatGPT to tell court of son's 'caring nature'
items.description: The mother of a man found guilty of murdering underworld figure Gavin Preston has told the Supreme Court her son has always been polite and considerate.

items.title: Gus Lamont's grandparent fined over gun offence, unrelated to 4yo's disappearance
items.description: The grandparent of missing four-year-old Gus Lamont has been fined $10,500 for possession of a gun silencer at the family's Oak Park Station, in South Australia's far north. Police have previously said the offence is not related to his disappearance.

items.title: Federal government has contracts worth more than $650m with embattled KPMG
items.description: Parliamentary library data reveals the federal government has almost 300 active contracts with accounting firm KPMG, which is being investigated over claims it misused confidential client information.

items.title: NDIS spending cuts would see 240,000 people exit the scheme, inquiry told
items.description: More than 240,000 people would exit the National Disability Insurance Scheme (NDIS) over four years according to modelling as part of a plan to cut spending on the multi-billion-dollar program.

items.title: Thai princess dies aged 47 after spending years in a coma
items.description: Princess Bajrakitiyabha Narendira Debyavati, who had spent the past three and a half years in a coma due to a heart condition, is being remembered for her efforts to improve the livelihoods of female prisoners and her diplomatic career.

items.title: UK minister's shock exit derails Australians' defence visit
items.description: Defence Minister Richard Marles's visit to the United Kingdom has been thrown into chaos after his British counterpart John Healey resigned hours before they were due to speak.

items.title: Viral lookout reopens after tourists used yards as 'toilets'
items.description: Lincolns Rock shut after crowds flocked to the site to recreate a photo posted on Instagram of a K-pop star dangling her legs off the sandstone cliff.

items.title: What are the rules around using fire pits at home?
items.description: There are rules when it comes to using fire pits and things to be cautious about, including open-air fires being a nuisance to your neighbours.

items.title: Why this fashion designer sells her clothes on social media not shops
items.description: Katharina Mildren's clothes have attracted legions of fans online and she ships items around the world, but there is one place you will not find her garments: in a shop.

items.title: Roxane Gay and Channing Tatum join forces thanks to this Australian
items.description: It's possible the ball may not have got rolling on Roxane Gay and Channing Tatum's upcoming novel if it wasn't for an Australian connection. Gay will appear at Vivid Sydney in a wide-ranging discussion.

items.title: Independence leader vanishes after changing sides to support Indonesia's government
items.description: A key Indigenous leader in West Papua appeared in a documentary criticising an Indonesian government program, but then changed sides and disappeared. Her family suspects foul play.

items.title: 'Broken promise' or not, Albanese's tax decision helps One Nation
items.description: The prime minister's cavalier breaking of election promises has poured kerosene on the fire under a party that can no longer be called "minor".

items.title: How One Nation could disrupt Australia's progressive stronghold
items.description: The idea that One Nation could come close to the government benches was absurd six months ago, but it is a prospect Victorian Labor MPs and insiders are increasingly discussing.

items.title: How you and your superannuation came to be aboard SpaceX
items.description: If your superannuation is managed by any of Australia's big superannuation funds, chances are you're about to become a highly valued financial backer to Elon Musk.

items.title: Government agencies fail first hurdle under AI self-reporting policy
items.description: The ABC can reveal dozens of federal agencies missed mandatory deadlines to disclose how they are currently using AI.

items.title: Greens say premier's answers about legal fees 'paint a far worse picture'
items.description: Tasmanian Premier Jeremy Rockliff has provided answers to a series of questions about former minister Madeleine Ogilvie's legal fees matter, but the Greens say they "paint a far worse picture of this shameful saga and his role in it".

items.title: Court hears of 'tragic mistake' that caused fatal Canberra crash
items.description: The daughters of a motorcyclist killed in Canberra's north tried to reach him for their nightly phone call as he lay dying on the road, an ACT court has heard.

items.title: 21yo man dies after stabbing on Tennant Creek street
items.description: A 21-year-old man has died after he was stabbed on a Tennant Creek street overnight, with police saying they believe a large crowd was in the area during the incident.
